name: Cardinals Promise
description: Cardinals Promise (CARD) is a fixed-cap ERC-20 token on Ethereum. Maximum supply is hard-capped on-chain at 250,000,000 CARD. A single flat 2% transfer fee accrues to a fixed treasury address and cannot be changed by anyone; there are no other fees, no blocklists, and no pausing.
notes: Official site: cp17.org, the coin's only web property, owned by the founder. By decision there is no bundle, giveaway, or claim program of any kind: CARD trades on Uniswap only, and the book The Cardinal's Promise is sold entirely separately with no coins attached. Fill in contract addresses after deployment before submitting to Etherscan token update, CoinGecko, or a Uniswap token list. Etherscan requires a 32x32 PNG icon — use assets/logo-32.png.
